dynamiclights.config.title: Dynamic Lights Settings
dynamiclights.config.category.entities.d: Light sources tied to items and mobs.
dynamiclights.config.category.special.de: Situational effects: fire, creepers, guardians, wardens and TNT.
dynamiclights.config.player.tooltip: Dynamic lights for YOU: a torch held in your own hand lights up the area, you light up while on fire. Does not apply to other entities (see Entities).
dynamiclights.config.entities.tooltip: Dynamic lighting for every entity other than you: other players, a zombie holding a torch, a burning skeleton... Your own light is always controlled by the switch above.
dynamiclights.config.items.tooltip: Items held in hand or dropped on the ground give off the light of what they are (torches, glowstone, lanterns...).
dynamiclights.config.glow_squids.tooltip: Glow squids light up their surroundings, matching their own glow.
dynamiclights.config.fireballs.tooltip: Fireballs (from blazes and ghasts) light up their surroundings while in flight.
dynamiclights.config.spectral_arrows.too: Spectral arrows light up their surroundings while in flight.
dynamiclights.config.allays.tooltip: Allays give off a gentle glow of their own.
dynamiclights.config.on_fire.tooltip: Any entity currently on fire lights up its surroundings.
dynamiclights.config.creeper_swell.toolt: Dynamic lighting for a swelling creeper. Off disables it, Simple uses a constant brightness, Fancy ramps up as it is about to explode.
dynamiclights.config.guardian_lasers.too: Dynamic lighting for a guardian's beam. Off disables it, Fast shows a cheaper single point of light, Fancy lights up the whole path between the guardian and its target.
dynamiclights.config.warden_sonic_boom.t: Flashes briefly when a warden unleashes its sonic boom.
dynamiclights.config.tnt.tooltip: Dynamic lighting for primed TNT. Off disables it, Simple uses a constant brightness, Fancy brightens as the fuse nears zero.
